"T've known Jeff for fifteen years. Terrific guy," Trump booms from a speakerphone. "He's a lot of fun to be with. It is even said that he likes beautiful women as much as I do, and many of them are on the younger side. No doubt about

it -- Jeffrey enjoys his social life."

That story will never die.

Landon Thomas, Jr.
Financial Reporter New York Times
